Aston Villa v Manchester City (Kick-off 12.30pm). Coverage of the top-flight match from Villa Park. Villa did the league double over their visitors last season as they claimed 1-0 and 2-1 wins. Matty Cash's 19th-minute goal was enough to give the hosts victory in this meeting last year before they slightly ruined Pep Guardiola's farewell on the last day of the Premier League season back in May.

Bristol Bears v Exeter Chiefs (Kick-off 5.30pm). Coverage of the match from the fourth round of fixtures at Ashton Gate. These two sides last met in the Premiership Rugby Cup last month as Exeter claimed a stunning 45-21 victory at home. The game was in the balance at half-time with the Chiefs winning 17-7, but four second-half tries for Exeter took the game away from the Bears.
